headline: ARCward Intelligence surges to the edge of ARC-2 gold

sections.text: ARCward Intelligence gained 15.84 points and jumped from 1,208th to 16th, scoring 45.42. It is now the first team outside ARC-2’s 15 gold places.
The gold line rose to 47.92, leaving ARCward Intelligence 2.50 points short. Its climb puts a fresh challenger directly on the medal boundary.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
